title: exordium.mod.json
description: An Exordium mod's own description of itself, in the root of its folder in MODS. Used when the folder has no D2SE_SETUP.ini. Read by apps/desktop/server.ts (readExordiumMod).

title.description: The mod's name as the library shows it. Default: the folder name.

name.description: Accepted in place of title; title wins when both are set.

core.description: The core the mod runs on: a D2SE core, as its folder in D2SE\CORES is named, or 1.14d when the install itself is 1.14d. A 1.14d mod runs Blizzard's own Game.exe, so D2Mod, Nefex, D2Extra and the D2SE DLLs cannot load; PlugY (11 or later) and plain DLLs can.

author.description: Shown as "BY …" at the top of the mod's page. The player can also set it in Properties → About.

description.description: A few paragraphs about the mod, shown as "About this mod" on its Overview. Line breaks are kept.

readme.description: The mod's readme: a file in its folder (listed first under Documentation), or a web address (shown as a Readme link).

update.description: Where Exordium checks for this mod's own updates. The endpoint may be http(s), absolute local path, or relative to the mod folder.

endpoint.description: A JSON manifest with either { version, downloads } or { releases: [...] }.

manifest.description: Accepted in place of endpoint; endpoint wins when both are set.

art.description: Artwork the mod ships, as image files in its folder. Artwork the player sets in Properties → Artwork takes precedence.

banner.description: The page header, shown full width. PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or BMP, about 1920×500 or larger.

icon.description: The library list, the game's taskbar icon (Game.exe) and desktop shortcuts. PNG only (it is embedded as PNG-in-ICO), 256×256.

portrait.description: For the grid view. PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or BMP, 600×900.

links.description: Shown in the Links card. Only http(s) addresses are kept; the kind (Discord, GitHub, ModDB, forum…) is read from the address.

launch.description: How the game starts. Each is a default the player can change in Properties → General.

renderer.description: glide = 3dfx (-3dfx), ddraw = DirectDraw, d3d = Direct3D (-d3d), opengl = -opengl.

direct.description: -direct: read loose files from the mod's data folder before the MPQs. Also on whenever PlugY is, as under D2SE.

plugY.description: Load PlugY (the mod's own PlugY.dll, else the install's).

language.description: A Language_<code> folder to load (ENG, DEU, …), or MOD for the mod's own text.

skipToBNet.description: -skiptobnet: start at the Battle.net login screen.

seed.description: -seed <number>: pass a map seed to the game. Exordium keeps only decimal digits.

startAct.description: -actN: new single-player characters start in Act N.

loads.description: What the loader loads besides the game.

mpqs.description: The mod's MPQs, lowest priority first, all above patch_d2.mpq (which the game always opens itself). The language MPQ loads above all of them. No limit.

d2mod.description: Load D2Mod.dll, which loads the plugins its D2Mod.ini lists.

dlls.description: Other plugin DLLs to load, in order. D2SE imports map from ModDll1, ModDll2, …, but Exordium does not cap the list at three.

realm.description: Private realm settings carried from D2SE_SETUP.ini. Null fields are ignored.

renderer.description: Flat form of launch.renderer; launch wins.
